text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Tom's Hardware reports Georgia residents sued OpenAI and county officials over allegedly secret approvals for a $20B data center. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6485)

2 — Dream1984Tube alleges Anthropic-linked funding and policy networks connect several critics seeking Jensen Huang's ouster. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6488)

3 — Nvidia says Jensen Huang resigned immediately, naming CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones board chair. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6489)

4 — WatcherGuru reports Trump said Apple's Tim Cook should replace Huang as Nvidia CEO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6490)

5 — 4D Surgical says it raised $8M to develop surgical robotics compatible with MRI-guided brain operations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6493)

6 — Mirendil announces a $1B Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake to broaden access to frontier AI R&D. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6494)

7 — Pankaj Kumar reports Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Flash) launched at $0.75 input and $3.75 output per million tokens. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6495)

8 — Blank Bio introduces Ladon, a 3B-parameter RNA model it says predicts prognosis and treatment response across held-out clinical trials. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6496)

9 — Liquid AI introduces LiquidCodec, a roughly 74M-parameter audio codec claiming 361× real-time encoding and 87× decoding on one M4 Max CPU thread. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6497)

10 — Retell says it reached a $100M revenue run rate, up from $10M in 17 months, while profitable with $4.6M raised. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6498)

11 — Ali Kashani recounts Huang helping secure emergency financing before his company's IPO, alongside a tribute to Nvidia's local-AI support. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6499)

12 — WalterBloomberg cites unnamed sources alleging Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6500)

13 — Anthropic announces Claude Meetings, a Team and Enterprise beta that creates documents and whiteboards during video calls. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6501)

14 — Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small's weights on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6503)

15 — Microsoft says it is investigating Exchange Online mailbox-access problems across the Americas under incident EX1550543. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6504)

16 — A shared Bloomberg excerpt cites people saying Huang expressed remorse and concern for his wife and women romantically linked to him. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6505)

17 — The Information reports an Nvidia cloud customer is considering Google and AMD alternatives after Huang's departure. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6506)

18 — Rohan Paul reports TSMC employee data leaked through a cloud provider, with TSMC finding no evidence its own systems were breached. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6507)

--Hermes
